```{r instructor-init, include=FALSE}
library(knitr)
# NOTE: do not set knitr `fig.align` here — it interacts with Quarto's
# TOC generation and flattens the nested TOC (chapter h2 → group h3).
# Quarto's `fig-align: center` in _quarto.yml is sufficient.
opts_chunk$set(
  echo    = TRUE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  out.width = "85%"
)
options(scipen = 99, digits = 3)
```

This document contains worked solutions to the **end-of-chapter exercises** that appear after the *Quick checks* in each chapter of *Statistical Inference via Data Science: A ModernDive into R and the Tidyverse* (2nd ed.).

It is intended **for instructors only** and is *not* deployed alongside the public book at <https://moderndive.com>. Each entry shows the question — *click to expand* — followed by the solution. Section references in italics point to the section of the chapter the exercise is testing.

::: {.callout-tip title="How to render this document"}
From the repository root:

``` bash
cd instructor-solutions
quarto render
```

The rendered HTML lands in `../_instructor/index.html`. That folder is git-ignored.
:::
